original_text:
Rule 1: No content from the data room may be sent, uploaded, or
transmitted to any destination outside the engagement workspace. Any
shell command that attempts network transmission is forbidden.
Rule 2: Material from any document marked as privileged or attorney work
product must never be quoted or reproduced in any output document. An
output document that contains text reproduced from a privilege-marked
document is forbidden.
Rule 3: A final deliverable of the red-flag review may not be written
until every document in the data room has been reviewed. Writing a final
deliverable while any data room document remains unreviewed is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var isDataRoomContentInvolved (Bool): True if the action involves content that originates from the data room.
(declare-const isDataRoomContentInvolved Bool)
; var isTransmissionAction (Bool): True if the action attempts to send, upload, or transmit content to some destination.
(declare-const isTransmissionAction Bool)
; var transmissionDestination (Int): The destination category of the content transmission being attempted.
; transmissionDestination values: TransmissionDestination_INSIDE_WORKSPACE = 0, TransmissionDestination_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE = 1, TransmissionDestination_OTHER = 2
(declare-const transmissionDestination Int)
; var isShellCommandAttemptingNetworkTransmission (Bool): True if the action is a shell command that attempts network transmission of content.
(declare-const isShellCommandAttemptingNetworkTransmission Bool)
; var isTransmissionAllowed (Bool): True if the attempted transmission or shell command action is permitted under the rules.
(declare-const isTransmissionAllowed Bool)
; var isSourceDocumentPrivileged (Bool): True if the source document is marked as privileged or as attorney work product.
(declare-const isSourceDocumentPrivileged Bool)
; var isOutputDocumentReproducingSourceText (Bool): True if an output document quotes or reproduces text from the source document.
(declare-const isOutputDocumentReproducingSourceText Bool)
; var isOutputDocumentAllowed (Bool): True if producing the output document is permitted under the rules.
(declare-const isOutputDocumentAllowed Bool)
; var isWritingFinalDeliverable (Bool): True if the action is writing a final deliverable of the red-flag review.
(declare-const isWritingFinalDeliverable Bool)
; var areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed (Bool): True if every document in the data room has been reviewed.
(declare-const areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed Bool)
; var totalDataRoomDocuments (Int): The total number of documents in the data room. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const totalDataRoomDocuments Int)
; var reviewedDataRoomDocuments (Int): The number of data room documents that have been reviewed. Must be zero or greater and no more than totalDataRoomDocuments.
(declare-const reviewedDataRoomDocuments Int)
; var isFinalDeliverableAllowed (Bool): True if writing the final deliverable of the red-flag review is permitted under the rules.
(declare-const isFinalDeliverableAllowed Bool)
; Rule MFJJF99YCK1C (if the following 3 statements are true: 1) isDataRoomContentInvolved is true; 2) isTransmissionAction is true; 3) transmissionDestination is equal to TransmissionDestination_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE, then isTransmissionAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (and isDataRoomContentInvolved
         isTransmissionAction
         (= transmissionDestination
            1))
    (not isTransmissionAllowed)))
; Rule K736PCY28DEM (if isShellCommandAttemptingNetworkTransmission is true, then isTransmissionAllowed is false)
(assert (=> isShellCommandAttemptingNetworkTransmission
    (not isTransmissionAllowed)))
; Rule JP15CFVD0KHT (if isSourceDocumentPrivileged is true and isOutputDocumentReproducingSourceText is true, then isOutputDocumentAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (and isSourceDocumentPrivileged
         isOutputDocumentReproducingSourceText)
    (not isOutputDocumentAllowed)))
; Rule AWSQV9ZZST4A (totalDataRoomDocuments is at least 0)
(assert (>= totalDataRoomDocuments
    0))
; Rule RM7VO2ED37RD (if isWritingFinalDeliverable is true and isFinalDeliverableAllowed is true, then areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed is true)
(assert (=> (and isWritingFinalDeliverable
         isFinalDeliverableAllowed)
    areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed))
; Rule ANAI6JZ9W81Y (if areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed is true, then reviewedDataRoomDocuments is equal to totalDataRoomDocuments)
(assert (=> areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed
    (= reviewedDataRoomDocuments
       totalDataRoomDocuments)))
; Rule C2W8WKUDC4Q9 (if areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed is false, then reviewedDataRoomDocuments is not equal to totalDataRoomDocuments)
(assert (=> (not areAllDataRoomDocumentsReviewed)
    (not (= reviewedDataRoomDocuments
            totalDataRoomDocuments))))
; Rule BCMJ90XHUQYZ (reviewedDataRoomDocuments is at least 0)
(assert (>= reviewedDataRoomDocuments
    0))
; Rule KOQ8NL5PUER0 (reviewedDataRoomDocuments is no more than totalDataRoomDocuments)
(assert (<= reviewedDataRoomDocuments
    totalDataRoomDocuments))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
